#ifndef ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_
#define ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_

#include <zephyr/ztest.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/__assert.h>
#include <zephyr/toolchain.h>
#include <zephyr/types.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/*
 * @brief Fail the current test with a message.
 *
 * This function is called by the zassert_* macros when an assertion fails.
 *
 * @param msg The message to print.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
void ztest_test_fail_msg(const char *msg, ...);

/*
 * @brief Helper macro for assertions.
 *
 * This macro is used by all zassert_* macros to implement the actual assertion
 * logic. It checks a condition and, if false, calls ztest_test_fail_msg.
 *
 * @param cond The condition to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the condition is false.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG(cond, msg, ...) \
    do { \
        if (!(cond)) { \
            ztest_test_fail_msg(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
        } \
    } while (0)

/*
 * @brief Assert that a condition is true.
 *
 * @param cond The condition to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the condition is false.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_true(cond, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG(cond, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that a condition is false.
 *
 * @param cond The condition to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the condition is true.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_false(cond, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG(!(cond), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that two values are equal.
 *
 * @param a The first value.
 * @param b The second value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG((a) == (b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that two values are not equal.
 *
 * @param a The first value.
 * @param b The second value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG((a) != (b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that two values are equal (integer type).
 *
 * @param a The first integer value.
 * @param b The second integer value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal_int(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG((int)(a) == (int)(b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that two values are not equal (integer type).
 *
 * @param a The first integer value.
 * @param b The second integer value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal_int(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG((int)(a) != (int)(b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that two values are equal (long type).
 *
 * @param a The first long value.
 * @param b The second long value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal_long(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG((long)(a) == (long)(b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that two values are not equal (long type).
 *
 * @param a The first long value.
 * @param b The second long value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal_long(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG((long)(a) != (long)(b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that two values are equal (pointer type).
 *
 * @param a The first pointer value.
 * @param b The second pointer value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal_ptr(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG((const void *)(a) == (const void *)(b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that two values are not equal (pointer type).
 *
 * @param a The first pointer value.
 * @param b The second pointer value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal_ptr(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG((const void *)(a) != (const void *)(b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that a value is NULL.
 *
 * @param ptr The pointer to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the pointer is not NULL.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_is_null(ptr, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG((ptr) == NULL, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that a value is not NULL.
 *
 * @param ptr The pointer to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the pointer is NULL.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_null(ptr, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG((ptr) != NULL, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that two memory blocks are equal.
 *
 * @param ptr1 The first memory block.
 * @param ptr2 The second memory block.
 * @param size The size of the memory blocks to compare.
 * @param msg The message to print if the memory blocks are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_mem_equal(ptr1, ptr2, size, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG(memcmp(ptr1, ptr2, size) == 0, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that two memory blocks are not equal.
 *
 * @param ptr1 The first memory block.
 * @param ptr2 The second memory block.
 * @param size The size of the memory blocks to compare.
 * @param msg The message to print if the memory blocks are equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_mem_not_equal(ptr1, ptr2, size, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG(memcmp(ptr1, ptr2, size) != 0, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that a value is within a range.
 *
 * @param val The value to check.
 * @param ref The reference value.
 * @param delta The allowed delta from the reference value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the value is outside the range.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_within_delta(val, ref, delta, msg, ...) \
    Z_TEST_ASSERT_MSG(((val) >= ((ref) - (delta))) && ((val) <= ((ref) + (delta))), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/*
 * @brief Assert that the current code path is unreachable.
 *
 * This macro should be used in code paths that are expected to never be
 * reached. If it is reached, the test will fail.
 *
 * @param msg The message to print.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_unreachable(msg, ...) \
    do { \
        ztest_test_fail_msg(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
    } while (0)

/*
 * @brief Assert that the current code path is not reached.
 *
 * This macro is an alias for zassert_unreachable.
 *
 * @param msg The message to print.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_reached(msg, ...) \
    zassert_unreachable(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_ */
